title: Red Hat Security Advisory: qt6-qtbase security update
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the Qt software toolkit's qt6-qtbase package. One issue involves denial of service via an excessively large HTTP Cache-Control header (CVE-2026-76151), and the other involves denial of service through crafted XML parsing in QXmlStreamReader (CVE-2026-16762). These vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 and related CodeReady Linux Builder products. Red Hat has released security updates to address these issues.
